verdict.rationale: Modal publishes its own SDK API reference (for example, the Sandbox and SandboxSnapshot class pages), code snippets in its JS/Go guide, and full worked examples such as the coding-agent example. There is no evidence that the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in the docs, and no OpenAPI spec was found that could drive a try-it console. Missing for 10: interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable-from-docs examples, OpenAPI/try-it console, independent corroboration of the docs experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: A `Sandbox` object lets you interact with a running sandbox. This API is similar to Python's asyncio.subprocess.Process
This example demonstrates how to build an LLM coding "agent" that can generate and execute Python code, using documentation from the web to inform its approach.
